names.note: saint.gr prints this name in Latin letters on its Greek page, both in the heading «Αγιος Boris ο Μαρτυρας (; - 1918)» and in the body, «ο υιός του Boris», and gives no Greek spelling of it; the calendar's own line for 31 Μαΐου spells it «Βόρις». The form recorded here is the life page's, exactly as it stands.

The heading of the calendar’s name link, «Борис (Орнатский), мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off; the day’s own line gives the bare «Бориса». `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «борис орнатскии» before the write, and the bare «Борис» was deliberately not stored, the corpus holding the passion-bearer of Kiev and others.

birth.note: The year the calendar states: «сын, Борис (родился в 1887 году), штабс-капитан 23-й артиллерийской бригады». The folder had no birth before this row.

death.note: The year the Russian day line prints for him with his father and brother, and the year this folder already held from saint.gr. No day was written: the calendar gives the shooting as a guess, «предположительно около 30 октября 1918 года».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Философа пресвитера и сыновей его мчч. Бориса и Николая (1918).»

attestations.note: The identification is the line’s own: it names him a son of the presbyter Philosophos, which is what this folder’s display name says. The calendar gives the three of them one life, life4927. `dates` GAINED A BIRTH IT DID NOT HAVE: «сын, Борис (родился в 1887 году), штабс-капитан 23-й артиллерийской бригады, закончивший Константиновское артиллерийское училище, геройски сражался на Австро-Венгерском фронте» — born in 1887, which is also the ground of the `soldier` type this folder already carries. The death 1918 is unchanged and no day was written: the calendar guesses the date of the shooting, «предположительно около 30 октября 1918 года», and guesses the place twice. HIS PAGES LIST THREE DAYS, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 31 мая , 8 июня (Петерб.)», the first the general synaxis of the new martyrs and the third a Petersburg local day; both are notes. `philosophos-ornatsky` and `nicholas-son-of-philosophos` already stand as `related` rows and the Russian bears both out. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Φιλόσοφος ο Ιερομάρτυρας και οι συν αυτώ Βόρις και Νικόλαος οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him his own heading beside his father's and his brother's, so the enumerated company is one folder per man. `soldier` is on the page's own word: «ο υιός του Boris είχε διορισθεί ως αρχηγός της 23ης ταξιαρχίας πυροβολικού και πολέμησε ηρωικά στο αυστρο-ουγγρικό μέτωπο». **The one name form is in Latin letters** because that is how the life page prints it; the day listing's Greek «Βόρις» is quoted in the name note rather than entered as a second form, since it is the same name in the other script and not a second recorded form. No hymn is printed for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
